verdict.rationale: Cognee's CLI and Python API expose memory operations (remember/recall/improve/forget) via plain natural-language queries, with recall() auto-classifying query intent, and the CLI explicitly supports asking questions from the terminal without writing code. This is corroborated by a runtime probe showing cognee-cli demo answering a natural-language question ('Who works at Anthropic?') end-to-end locally without any LLM key. missing for 10: independent/third-party review of natural-language command breadth beyond recall/demo, and richer docs on command syntax variety beyond the four core verbs.
